import re
import sys

env = {}
text = sys.stdin.read()

for name, value in re.findall(r"\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*|\d+)", text):
    env[name] = env[value] if value.isdigit() is False and value in env else int(value) if value.isdigit() else env[value]

order = ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {env[name]}" for name in order) + ";")
